name: figma-plugin
description: Deep Figma design capabilities on top of a local native execution and multi-window routing kernel.

interface.longDescription: Connect agents to local Figma Design, FigJam, or Slides windows through a native execution + typed export kernel, then apply deep Figma Skills for design craft, reusable components/prototypes, design systems, cross-file design reuse/migration, verification, and design/code translation.
defaultPrompt: Set up or diagnose the local Figma Plugin connection and tell me the exact next action.
Design or revise this Figma screen using the appropriate deep Figma capabilities and reuse the existing system.
Audit this fixed Figma artifact with evidence-backed verification, or improve the owning design-system domain when repair is requested.
Translate between this Figma design system and the production codebase without duplicating existing design truth.
Reuse, migrate, fork, or synchronize this Figma design/library into another Figma file without losing the intended update path.
